verdict.rationale: Name.com documents per-domain autorenew as a domain setting (docs-23). A dedicated guide covers auto-renew, manual renew, post-expiration recovery and a Guaranteed Renewal Window (docs-32), and webhook subscriptions cover renewal events (docs-26). missing for 10: explicit expiry-reminder email notices to the registrant, concrete grace/redemption durations and fees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
